_comment: LEVEL 3 (feature): in-memory token-bucket rate limiter as a FastAPI dependency — subtle concurrency logic that is safer to copy than to generate. No extra deps.
name: feature-rate-limit
description: Token-bucket rate limiter: FastAPI dependency factory (per-IP or per-user), 429 + Retry-After. No extra deps.
notes: Usage: dependencies=[Depends(rate_limit('5/minute'))] on a route, or rate_limit('10/minute', key=user_key) for per-user limits (see user_key — it reads the Bearer token directly so it works before get_current_user runs). In-memory bucket: resets on restart; swap _BUCKETS for a redis-backed store in multi-worker deployments. Returns HTTP 429 with Retry-After.
